pharmacy-pos.name: MediCore POS — Pharmacy Point of Sale & Inventory System
pharmacy-pos.description: A premium pharmacy point-of-sale and inventory management system built for Philippine community pharmacies — VAT-aware checkout, batch & expiry tracking, purchase orders, audit logs, roles, and reports.
pharmacy-pos.techStack: Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Recharts

obo-pams.name: OBO-PAMS — Permit Application Management System
obo-pams.description: A role-based permit application management system for the Office of the Building Official (LGU-General Santos) — order of payment encoding, permit workflow tracking, approval, releasing records, on-site ocular inspection checklists, team leaders, reports, and audit logs.
